name: Weep
author: E. T. Carter
description: Rain on a night window: beaded drops and slow stick-slip runnels that meander down a misted pane, leaving clear wet tracks and stranded beads, each drop a small lens bending the city behind it. Beyond the glass, out-of-focus pink, mint and blue street lights and moving car lights pool above long reflections on a wet road, under a violet cloud deck lit from below.

params.label: Rain
params.effect: How many drops and runnels bead the glass, from a nearly dry pane to a streaming one.

params.label: Mist
params.effect: How much condensation veils the city between the drops.

params.label: Focus depth
params.effect: How far out of focus the street lights sit, from crisp to large soft discs.

params.label: Runnel speed
params.effect: How fast drops let go and slide down the pane.
